summary: Learn TNFD LEAP, ENCORE and GIS screening to prioritize nature risks. Build a portfolio assessment and action plan. Explore the course.
lede: Nature-related risk assessment helps ESG, environmental and finance teams identify how activities depend on and affect nature. Using TNFD LEAP, ENCORE and GIS screening, participants map dependencies and impacts, assess risks and opportunities, and prioritize responses. The course also covers stakeholder evidence and action planning for project, portfolio and supply-chain decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess nature-related exposure or need to bring geographic evidence into investment, project, ESG, or supply-chain decisions.
prerequisites: Recommended prior experience: working familiarity with ESG, environmental assessment, GIS, lending, investment, infrastructure, extractives, or development-programme decisions. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel; QGIS is used for practical GIS screening, so install it before the course if available.
